facts.fact: The PROGOUV terms of reference say street addressing exists only in a few central streets and in Ras Dika commune, with street plates but no door numbers, that a pilot ran in Cite Nassib (Balbala), and that the Mairie holds DJF 70 million for 2023 addressing and seeks an expert to define a city addressing strategy.
facts.system: Municipal street addressing, Ville de Djibouti
